name: コヒーレンス分析
description: Measures text coherence and logical flow consistency.
useCase: Detecting AI text through unnaturally smooth coherence
mechanism: Measures sequential similarity between content segments. AI-generated text often maintains unnaturally high coherence throughout, while human text naturally varies.
source: Zellers et al. (2019) - Defending Against Neural Fake News, NeurIPS
parameters: Window size: adaptive, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: entropy, CV, correlation
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI-generated text
- Language-agnostic statistical approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger false positives
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies across writing styles

references.title: Zellers et al. (2019) - Defending Against Neural Fake News, NeurIPS
